description: Flow dictation HUD overlay (a local page, not the remote PWA). Listens for the global-hotkey + session events, records the push-to-talk clip, calls the Flow API, and invokes the app's own inject_text / flow_copy_selection commands to paste into the focused app. Local origin = it may call those commands directly (same trust boundary as the dedup window); it never exposes native input to the cloud.
